description: A hyperlane chokepoint and strategically vital region of space. Early-project canon attests it three independent ways: as "a strategically vital region of space", as "a hyperlane chokepoint" where Separatist hardliners were observed amassing forces (per Union Intelligence intercepts), and as the setting of the Sovereign Nexus Crisis — a high-stakes multi-faction standoff.

disambiguation.relationship: UNDETERMINED. The two referents are distinct — one a region, one an intelligence — and both are independently attested. Whether the AI is named for this place, operates from it, or the name was simply reused across project eras is NOT established by canon and was not inferred.
disambiguation.basis: The place reading is supported by three independent characterisations in the early prose; the AI reading by the Obsidian Dawn outcome file. Neither displaces the other.
